deepDiveBlocks.heading: Oral Contraception Supply And Safety Checks
paragraphs: The NHS Pharmacy Contraception Service allows commissioned pharmacies to supply selected oral contraception after assessment, including blood pressure checks and contraindication screening.
Some presentations require GP or specialist referral rather than pharmacy supply — suitability is confirmed individually, not from online information alone.

preparationGuide: Medical history including migraine and VTE risk
Recent blood pressure reading if known
timelineNotes: BP check at supply or renewal
comparisonPoints: Not all contraceptive methods are in pharmacy scope
Sexual health clinics for complex cases
